Is the 5 Second Rule True? — You drop a cookie and yell FIVE-SECOND RULE! Wait—can germs really count to 5?
Kids science answer for "is the 5 second rule true for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Moisture and floor cleanliness matter far more than 5 seconds—bacteria can hop onto wet or sticky food almost the instant it hits the floor.
